name: psych-counseling
description: Psychological analysis and psychoeducation from Jungian and cognitive frameworks, with crisis-signal detection and referral. Analysis and support only; never diagnosis or treatment.

displayDescription.zh: 用荣格与认知心理学框架解释情绪、行为与梦，识别危机信号并转介。只做分析与支持，不做诊断与治疗。
displayDescription.en: Psychological analysis and psychoeducation from Jungian and cognitive frameworks, with crisis-signal detection and referral. Analysis and support only; never diagnosis or treatment.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我最近总做一个被追赶的梦，从荣格的角度可以怎么理解？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I keep dreaming of being chased. How would a Jungian approach understand this?

quickPrompts.zh: 我最近总做一个被追赶的梦，从荣格的角度可以怎么理解？
quickPrompts.en: I keep dreaming of being chased. How would a Jungian approach understand this?

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我用阴影工作的方式分析我一直回避的那部分自我。
quickPrompts.en: Walk me through shadow work on a part of myself I keep avoiding.

quickPrompts.zh: 我在团队决策里总随大流，从群体动力学角度解释一下原因。
quickPrompts.en: I always go along with the group in team decisions. Explain this through group dynamics.
